description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisitions of the land in Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under Section 33 of The Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation for a specific acquired land parcel (Enasaldora Watta). It contains detailed land information including plan number, lot number, extent, and boundary descriptions. The core subject matter is land acquisition and compensation, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
